name: 02 · Attendance Summary — GPS Check-ins → Daily Report → WhatsApp

nodes.name: Daily 6 PM Trigger (Mon–Sat)
nodes.notes: Fires every weekday + Saturday at 18:00 IST. Adjust the cron expression or timezone via GENERIC_TIMEZONE in docker-compose.

parameters.query:
SELECT
  e.id            AS employee_id,
  e.name          AS employee_name,
  e.department,
  e.manager_phone,
  ci.check_in_time,
  ci.check_out_time,
  ci.lat_in,
  ci.lng_in,
  ci.lat_out,
  ci.lng_out,
  ci.status,
  ROUND(
    EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ci.check_out_time - ci.check_in_time)) / 3600.0,
    2
  ) AS hours_worked
FROM check_ins ci
JOIN employees e ON e.id = ci.employee_id
WHERE ci.check_in_time::date = CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY e.department, e.name;
SELECT DISTINCT manager_phone FROM employees WHERE manager_phone IS NOT NULL AND active = true;
